plaques.text:
KETTLE FJORD

The ice comes in the Hearth-months, and the fishing moves out onto it.

pickups.label: Pry up what the ice holds
Chip the mitten free
pickups.audit_skip: the hole under it is thin ice until the release seals it (release_seal)

pickups.label: Look at the tracks
pickups.look:
One set of footprints, frozen in, going up the fjord by the thin ice in the middle where nobody walks.

The left stride is longer than the right. They do not go round anything.

edges.doc: tools/audit_edges.py: jetties and hut platforms are THAW/RIME floors; the RIME ice is a floor over the fjord.
